stop_stealing_chips_119.text: Artificial intelligence is the defining technology of the new Cold War. Whether the U.S. or China wins this race will be determined in large part by who has more and better chips. The Stop Stealing Our Chips Act will encourage those who witness chip smuggling to speak out while shielding them from retaliation.

deepseek.confidence_reason: The named bill is explicitly praised for its whistleblower effect, though the speaker does not say 'I support'.

export_controls.text: For too long, the Chinese Communist Party has exploited weaknesses in our export control enforcement system—using shell companies and smuggling networks to divert sensitive U.S. technology that helps fuel its military advancement and extend its surveillance capabilities to further its repression. That puts our national security and our leadership in artificial intelligence at risk.

export_controls.text: Artificial intelligence is the defining strategic asset of the 21st century, and the United States must lead its development, protection, and deployment. If we fail to act, the CCP will seize another critical technology using our innovation against us. That is why we need an America first AI policy, one that defends U.S. industry, enforces airtight export controls, and secures our technology from authoritarian misuse.

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls for an America first AI policy that enforces airtight export controls.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement explicitly endorses airtight export controls.

export_controls.text: Right now, American chips are being smuggled into China and used to train AI models that serve the CCP’s military and surveillance state. And we can’t allow that.

deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly opposes allowing chip smuggling to China, directly supporting enforcement.
